reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 000558 (the melody read from 000558a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. CCEH's page spells Thomas Campbell as “Campbell, Thomas”; the name is printed as the sources spell it. Thomas Campbell's dates are uncertain, so the page says only that they lived in the 19th century; they died by 1876 (https://hymnary.org/tune/sagina_campbell (SAGINA, by Thomas Campbell, first published in his The Bouquet, 1825; its biography, from Evans and Humphreys' Dictionary of Composers for the Church in Great Britain and Ireland: 'born in Sheffield, Yorkshire in 1800, died in Sheffield in 1876'). Hymnals on the same page print 1777-1844 (the poet Thomas Campbell's dates), 1824-1876 or 1825-1876, so his dates are uncertain; every one has him dead by 1876, and his tune was in print in 1825, before the pre-1850 rule's year. CCEH prints the name surname first). CCEH's page gives only the year 1865. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000558a.nwc).
